description: This is a C# source file for a UWP application, specifically the App.xaml.cs file, defining application lifecycle behavior, launch handling, and UI setup for the CalculatorApp.

classes.name: App
classes.description: Defines application lifecycle, launch, activation, and UI setup logic for the CalculatorApp.

methods.name: App
methods.description: Constructor initializing components, registering dependencies, and setting debug options.

methods.name: OnLaunched
methods.description: Handles normal app launch, sets user context, warms up view mode check, and calls app launch setup.

methods.name: OnActivated
methods.description: Handles app activation via protocol, processes protocol args, and initiates app launch.

methods.name: OnAppLaunch
methods.description: Performs UI setup, window sizing, navigation to main page, and theme initialization during app launch.

methods.name: OnSuspending
methods.description: Logs button usage when app is suspended.

methods.name: SetupJumpListAsync
methods.description: Configures the Windows Jump List with calculator categories based on view modes.
